slides.title: Fábulas de Esopo
slides.text: As fábulas de Esopo, como 'The Tortoise and the Hare', são lidas há mais de 2.500 anos. Todas terminam com uma moral. Em inglês: 'The moral of the story is…'.
Na hora da história, Eva conta a Mia uma fábula com início, meio e fim.
slides.line: Once upon a time, there was a small fox.

slides.title: The honest fox
slides.text: Once upon a time there was a small fox. She was hungry, so she looked for food in the forest. Suddenly she found a basket of berries, but a note said: 'For Anna.' The fox was very hungry, but she did not eat them. When Anna arrived, she saw the fox sitting next to the basket. "You didn't eat my berries," said Anna. "They aren't mine," said the fox. Anna smiled and gave the fox some berries as a thank you. The moral is: honesty is always rewarded.
slides.pt: Uma raposa esfomeada não come as frutas alheias e é recompensada.

slides.title: Marcadores de história
slides.text: 'Once upon a time' (era uma vez), 'one day' (um dia), 'suddenly' (de repente), 'finally' (finalmente) e 'happily ever after' (felizes para sempre) são marcadores que organizam qualquer história.
